flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company aims to increase the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of its revenue mix in FY2027.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months to expand its product portfolio.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has opened a branch at Kochi to target the furniture manufacturing hub.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Yes, 3 months before, we have been opened a branch at Kochi which is a very good manufacturing hub for the furniture." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: There is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market, leading to demand for solvent-free solutions.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Because now, there is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to reduce its debt 100%.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "No, plan is to reduce 100%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: The company does not expect working capital to become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to the company's import costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Price fluctuations in raw materials are driven by global supply and chain dynamics.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Global factors that are currently going on, based on that the price fluctuations that have come in raw material are coming, those are also coming upon global supply and the entire chain dynamics." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)
